name: PR Brief card renders the seeded brief and its top focus row deep-links into the diff
description: From PR #482's Overview tab, confirm the PR Brief card renders the seeded risk level and its ordered 'Review focus' list (a real seeded changed-file path in the top row), then click that top row and confirm it navigates IN-APP to the Files changed tab with ?tab=diff&file=...&line=... and that file renders in the diff viewer. The brief row for src/api/users.ts is deliberately the only file-ref button with that accessible name on the page (no risk row also cites src/api/users.ts), so the click target is unambiguous. Read-only seeded data (no model call) — the seeded pr_brief row's state_key matches what BriefService derives for PR #482, so the GET is a cache hit and composes nothing. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).

cmd: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints

navigate to the PR detail route

deep link carries the focus row's line number
the focused file renders in the diff viewer
